description.value:
Removes all safety and reason by firing almost 1000 rounds per minute, so don't bother aiming. Something's guaranteed to hit.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 90 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 5), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Foregrip, Folding Structure, Power Rebuild, Sling, SMG Cyclic Internals, SMG Short Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: While wielded in two hands, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality [Foregrip]. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 20 rounds instead of 10. If there are not 20 rounds left in the magazine, Autofire (SMG 5) expends the entire magazine as Autofire (SMG 4) instead. All Autofire Checks made with this weapon suffer a -1 penalty due to wild recoil. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Folding Structure, Power Rebuild, Sling, SMG Cyclic Internals, SMG Short Barrel (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
